```{r}
library(readxl)
library(tidyr)
library(dplyr)
library(ggstatsplot)
library(tidyverse)
library(readxl)
library(dlookr)
library(reshape2)
```


```{r}
gender_data <- read_excel("E:/Daten(x)/Daten(lw-r)/Abc/Doktorarbeit SJS/Analyse R-Statistics/gender plots - bmi/gender_info_full.xlsx",
           sheet = 1, skip = 1)

gender_data1 <- gender_data %>%
  dplyr::select(1:4) %>%
  dplyr::mutate(
    Gender = dplyr::case_when(
      Male == 1 ~ "Male",
      Female == 1 ~ "Female"
    ),
    value = dplyr::case_when(
      Male == 1 ~ 1,
      Female == 1 ~ 0
    )
  ) %>% 
  dplyr::select(1,2,5,6)%>% 
  drop_na()
gender_data1
```



### hb ##########################################################################
### diabetic #####################################################################
```{r}
hb_diabetes_gender <- left_join(gender_data1,hb_diabetic,by = "Edited_BfArM Nummer2") %>% 
  drop_na() %>% 
  mutate(Gender = as.factor(Gender))

hb_diabetes_gender
```
 
```{r}
hb_diabetic_gender <- hb_diabetes_gender %>% 
    filter(Diabetes == "Diabetic") 
hb_nondiabetic_gender <- hb_diabetes_gender %>% 
    filter(Diabetes == "Non_Diabetic") 
```
 
```{r}
hb_diabetic_gender %>% 
  group_by(Gender) %>% 
  normality(labreads)

tapply(hb_diabetic_gender$labreads, hb_diabetic_gender$Gender, var)
leveneTest(labreads ~ Gender, data = hb_diabetic_gender)

oneway.test(labreads ~ Gender, data = hb_diabetic_gender)
```


### nsaid comparison all labvalues #####################################################
```{r}
# Schritt 1: Anzahl einzigartiger Patienten pro Diabetes-Gruppe berechnen
n_patients <- hb_diabetic_gender %>%
  distinct(`Edited_BfArM Nummer2`, Gender) %>%  # nur einzigartige Patienten
  count(Gender, name = "n") %>%
  mutate(label = paste0("N = ", n))

# Schritt 2: ggbetweenstats-Plot erstellen
plot_without_count <- ggbetweenstats(
  data = hb_diabetic_gender,
  x = "Gender",
  y = "labreads",
  type = "np",  # non-parametrisch
  title = "All groups_gender comparison in diabetic group",
  xlab = "Patient group",
  ylab = "hb (g/dl)",
  messages = FALSE)

# Schritt 3: N-Werte oberhalb der Violinenplots_all_labvalues einfügen
all_hb_gender_comp_in_diabetic_group <- plot_without_count+ 
  geom_text(
    data = n_patients,
    aes(x = Gender, 
        y = max(hb_diabetic_gender$labreads, na.rm = TRUE) * 1.05,  # Position leicht oberhalb
        label = label),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    size = 4)

#all_hb_gender_comp_in_diabetic_group
dir.create("plots_all_labvalues/gender_comp/diab", showWarnings = FALSE)
svg("plots_all_labvalues/gender_comp/diab/all_hb_gender_comp_in_diabetic_group.svg", height = 6, width = 8)
print(all_hb_gender_comp_in_diabetic_group)
dev.off()
```

### gesamteiweiß ##########################################################################
### diabetic #####################################################################
```{r}
gesamteiweiß_diabetic <- left_join(gesamteiweiß_full, diabetic_data, c = "Edited_BfArM Nummer2") %>% 
  drop_na() %>% 
 # filter(Diabetes == "Diabetic") %>% 
  filter(!grepl("_From Start|_From start|DBS", attribute)) %>% 
  group_by(Diabetes) 

gesamteiweiß_diabetic
```

```{r}
gesamteiweiß_diabetes_gender <- left_join(gender_data1,gesamteiweiß_diabetic,by = "Edited_BfArM Nummer2") %>% 
  drop_na() %>% 
  mutate(Gender = as.factor(Gender))

gesamteiweiß_diabetes_gender
```
 
```{r}
gesamteiweiß_diabetic_gender <- gesamteiweiß_diabetes_gender %>% 
    filter(Diabetes == "Diabetic") 
gesamteiweiß_nondiabetic_gender <- gesamteiweiß_diabetes_gender %>% 
    filter(Diabetes == "Non_Diabetic") 
```
 
```{r}
gesamteiweiß_diabetic_gender %>% 
  group_by(Gender) %>% 
  normality(labreads)

tapply(gesamteiweiß_diabetic_gender$labreads, gesamteiweiß_diabetic_gender$Gender, var)
leveneTest(labreads ~ Gender, data = gesamteiweiß_diabetic_gender)

  count(Gender, name = "n") %>%
  mutate(label = paste0("N = ", n))

# Schritt 2: ggbetweenstats-Plot erstellen
plot_without_count <- ggbetweenstats(
  data = li_crp_diabetic_gender,
  x = "Gender",
  y = "labreads",
  type = "np",  # non-parametrisch
  title = "Liver ibu_gender comparison in diabetic group",
  xlab = "Patient group",
  ylab = "crp (mg/l)",
  messages = FALSE)

# Schritt 3: N-Werte oberhalb der Violinenplots_all_labvalues einfügen
li_crp_gender_comp_in_diabetic_group <- plot_without_count+ 
  geom_text(
    data = n_patients,
    aes(x = Gender, 
        y = max(li_crp_diabetic_gender$labreads, na.rm = TRUE) * 1.05,  # Position leicht oberhalb
        label = label),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    size = 4)

#li_crp_gender_comp_in_diabetic_group
dir.create("plots_all_labvalues/gender_comp/diab", showWarnings = FALSE)
svg("plots_all_labvalues/gender_comp/diab/li_crp_gender_comp_in_diabetic_group.svg", height = 6, width = 8)
print(li_crp_gender_comp_in_diabetic_group)
dev.off()
```

  data = kalzium_nondiabetic_gender,

        label = label),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    size = 4
  )

inr_nondiabetic_gender %>%

### nsaid comparison all labvalues #####################################################
```{r}
# Schritt 1: Anzahl einzigartiger Patienten pro Diabetes-Gruppe berechnen
n_patients <- inr_nondiabetic_gender %>%
  distinct(`Edited_BfArM Nummer2`, Gender) %>%  # nur einzigartige Patienten
  count(Gender, name = "n") %>%
  mutate(label = paste0("N = ", n))

# Schritt 2: ggbetweenstats-Plot erstellen
plot_without_count <- ggbetweenstats(
  data = inr_nondiabetic_gender,
  x = "Gender",
  y = "labreads",
  type = "np",  # non-parametrisch
  title = "All groups_gender comparison in nondiabetic group",
  xlab = "Patient group",
  ylab = "inr ",
  messages = FALSE)

# Schritt 3: N-Werte oberhalb der Violinenplots_all_labvalues einfügen
all_inr_gender_comp_in_nondiabetic_group <- plot_without_count+ 
  geom_text(
    data = n_patients,
    aes(x = Gender, 
        y = max(inr_nondiabetic_gender$labreads, na.rm = TRUE) * 1.05,  # Position leicht oberhalb
        label = label),
    inherit.aes = FALSE,
    size = 4
  )
#all_inr_gender_comp_in_nondiabetic_group
dir.create("plots_all_labvalues/gender_comp/nondiab", showWarnings = FALSE)
svg("plots_all_labvalues/gender_comp/nondiab/all_inr_gender_comp_in_nondiabetic_group.svg", height = 6, width = 8)
print(all_inr_gender_comp_in_nondiabetic_group)
dev.off()
```
